## Goal

### Data described once

`DataDescribedOnce` · `src/product.ts:11`

The data a product keeps outside the graph, from one version to the next (a person's breath on a device, the reservations of a database), is described once, in the graph: its type, its names, the form it is stored in, how what is stored is read, and how it migrates when the description changes, all come from that description.
